en.topic_title: Pushed not jumped: What a 19th-century shipwreck reveals about Hong Kong’s political casualties
en.topic_summary:
From an anthropological point of view, the government reaction to the Wang Fuk Court fire inquiry report makes for interesting reading. It criticised four arms of the government, after 168 people were killed in last November’s blaze in Tai Po.



Former secretary for housing Winnie Ho. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP.



Also, after a major catastrophe, one might question the future of the Chief Executive. However, only one policy secretary, the now former housing chief Winnie Ho, has actually resign
